# @loom/plugin-cloudrun

Cloud Run platform adapter for Loom — CloudRunWorkerRuntime maps DispatchMetadata to a Cloud Run sizing config, resolves a service endpoint, and invokes the stateless worker. Cloud specifics stay behind the CloudRunPlatform SPI

## Entry points

- `@loom/plugin-cloudrun`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
